name: TG Group Manager Bot
description: Production-ready Telegram group management bot with voice/video chat controls, sticker & chat control, moderation tools.

SESSION_STRING.description: Pyrogram session string for the VC-control assistant account (generate with generate_session.py)

MONGO_DB_URI.description: MongoDB connection URI (e.g. from MongoDB Atlas free tier)

OWNER_ID.description: Your numeric Telegram user ID (bot super-admin)

LOG_GROUP_ID.description: Numeric ID of a private group/channel the bot logs actions to (optional)
